finding: A single exhaustive workflow-run enumerator is not sufficient evidence by itself. Commit-bound deployment evidence should require agreement between two independently executed complete enumerations and fail closed on incompleteness, commit mismatch, duplicate identifiers, cross-commit records, missing run identifiers, or metadata divergence.

observations: R-020 requires an independent gh api --paginate comparison before complete coverage is accepted.
The primary enumerator reports completion, exact commit, pages fetched, runs, and pagination coverage.
The primary enumerator rejects cross-commit records but does not compare its output with an independent traversal.

source_status.source: GitHub REST workflow-run and pagination contracts recorded in R-020
observations: Exact-commit coverage uses head_sha without an event filter and complete pagination.
Filtered searches retain provider-ceiling ambiguity near 1000 results.

uncertainty: No authenticated all-event private-repository enumeration was available through the connected GitHub action surface in this run.
The independent gh api --paginate traversal has not yet been executed.
Equal outputs from two clients do not eliminate a shared upstream provider ceiling or shared API defect.
falsification_route: Execute the repository enumerator and an independent gh api --paginate traversal for the same full commit SHA.
Provide both complete result envelopes to the reconciler.
Any missing run ID, field mismatch, duplicate ID, cross-commit record, or incomplete envelope must prevent evidence acceptance.
Compare accepted run IDs with GitHub UI or workflow-specific endpoints; any omitted run falsifies the completeness claim.
design_implication: Vercel Studio should accept workflow-run evidence only after the exhaustive enumerator and an independent traversal both report complete coverage and this reconciliation gate returns verified=true. Provider-ceiling ambiguity remains a separate fail-closed condition.
